marks.gloss_en: the olah's head is not cut up, yet we do not fear a pierced brain membrane
R' Elazar: from the head of the olah, which is not cut into pieces ('it into its pieces, not its pieces into pieces') -- let us fear the brain membrane was pierced! rather, we follow the majority
ממאי? perhaps he splits it and checks -- 'not its pieces into pieces' is where he cuts it through, not where it stays joined
no bone of the Pesach is broken, yet we do not fear a pierced brain membrane
Mar breih deRavina: from the ban on breaking a bone of the Pesach (Ex 12:46) -- let us fear the brain membrane was pierced! rather, we follow the majority
ממאי? perhaps he places a coal on it, burns through and checks -- דתניא, burning bones is not breaking (p_baraita_soref_baatzamot)
the baraita: one who cuts the sinews or burns the bones [of the Pesach] does not violate breaking a bone
the fat-tail is offered whole, yet we do not fear a severed spinal cord
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: from the fat-tail, which must be whole (Lev 3:9) -- let us fear the spinal cord was severed! rather, we follow the majority
וכי תימא: he cuts it below [where the cord matters]
ממאי? perhaps he opens it and checks -- 'whole' means not cut through, not where it stays joined
the egla arufa must be whole, yet we do not fear a tereifa
Rav Sheshet breih deRav Idi: from the egla arufa, which must be whole but for its broken neck -- let us fear it is a tereifa! rather, we follow the majority
וכי תימא: what difference does it make [if it is a tereifa]?
devei R' Yannai: atonement is written of it, as of sacrifices
the red heifer is burned whole, yet we do not fear a tereifa
Rabba bar Rav Sheila: from the red heifer, burned whole as it was slaughtered whole -- let us fear it is a tereifa! rather, we follow the majority
וכי תימא: what difference does it make?
the two goats must be equal, yet we do not fear one is a tereifa
Rav Acha bar Yaakov: from the scapegoat -- the two goats must be equal; let us fear one is a tereifa! rather, we follow the majority
where a row of men stand and relay: it stands as it was
from where?! it is written 'after the majority to incline' (Ex 23:2)
a majority before us -- nine shops, the Sanhedrin -- is not in question
follow the majority -- including a majority not before us, as with a minor boy and girl
